expected_findings.description: thread_id in p.name is a substring check that could yield false positives if codex naming convention changes; should use p.stem.endswith(f"-{thread_id}") for precision
The sole-rollout fallback docstring should explicitly state that it can only match a rollout from the current run because CODEX_HOME is process-isolated
The rel variable is redundant; the stronger assertion on content already validates the restoration
write_text without explicit encoding= argument relies on locale-default encoding, which is technically fragile on non-UTF-8 systems
